name: Seeking for a whole soul
source:
This story is about a young guy who wants to help people... being the son of a medium, have special powers. A haunted high school is waiting for him.

[From [url=https://tete-chin.itch.io/seekingwholesoul]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一个年轻男孩的故事。他想帮助别人，身为灵媒之子，也拥有特殊能力。一所闹鬼的高中正等着他。

[来源：[url=https://tete-chin.itch.io/seekingwholesoul]Itch.io[/url]]
